During the discussion regarding the upcoming garden gathering, MalfurionStormrage expresses enthusiasm about the idea. He states, "It will be a wonderful place for everyone to gather and enjoy nature together." Additionally, he suggests setting up some seating areas that blend well with the surroundings, which would be perfect for relaxing after strolling through the garden. Furthermore, Malfurion mentions, "I think a rustic design would work well. It can blend nicely with the natural surroundings and create a cozy vibe. We could use wood or stone for that natural look." In terms of activities, he adds, "Let’s keep the ideas rolling for that gathering! I think some games or activities could make it even more fun." 

The responses indicate that the participants are considering a variety of fun activities, such as games for the children, which RexxarRemar suggests, "That’s a solid idea! Kids will love it, and it’ll keep everyone entertained while enjoying the garden." AdamSmith agrees and proposes, "We could set up a little area for them. Maybe some crafts or simple games? It’ll keep things lively!" Overall, the consensus appears to be that the gathering will be a mix of relaxation, enjoyment of the garden, and engaging activities that cater to all ages.
